title: Ranking every AI tool in 2026
description: Ranking every AI tool in 2026. Codex — S Tier One of the best tools for automating daily tasks and building apps and websites. Claude — A Tier Best writing tool, best strategic thinking partner, sounds the most human. ChatGPT — A Tier Still the best all around tool for beginners and their new image generator is insane. Supernormal — A Tier My go-to meeting notes tool. Turns your notes into action items automatically. Perplexity — A Tier Their computer is by far the best for deep research. Gemini — B Tier Really good if you’re looped into the Google ecosystem. Notion — B Tier A way better version of Apple Notes but not all the way there yet. Make — C Tier Powerful but you should just be using Claude Code. n8n — D Tier Powerful if you’re technical but most people wouldn’t know how to use it. Apple Intelligence — D Tier Please fix Siri, Apple. #ai #aitools #chatgpt #claude #productivity
